title: Output Schema for Send Request Operation
description: Output schema for the Solace sendRequest operation.

payload.description: The reply message content received from the responder. JSON replies are parsed into an object or array; non-JSON replies (text, XML, binary) are surfaced as a string. Inspect attributes.contentType to determine how to interpret it.

attributes.description: Metadata about the sendRequest operation and the received reply.

destination.description: The name of the topic or queue the request was sent to.

destinationType.description: The type of destination the request was sent to (e.g., TOPIC, QUEUE).

deliveryMode.description: The delivery mode used for the request (e.g., DIRECT, PERSISTENT, NON_PERSISTENT).

contentType.description: The content type of the reply payload (e.g., application/json, application/xml, text/plain).

correlationId.description: The correlation id of the reply message. Present only when the reply carried a correlation id.

applicationMessageId.description: The application-defined message id of the reply. Present only when set on the reply.

applicationMessageType.description: The application-defined message type of the reply. Present only when set on the reply.

receiveTimestamp.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the reply was received. Present only when greater than zero.

outcome.description: UNKNOWN when the deadline, an interrupt or a transport failure cut the request publish off after the send was entered. The request may or may not have reached the broker, so a retry is at least once. Absent otherwise.

headers.description: Transport headers associated with the response.
